scope: Two owned Standard/Express Pass/Wait machines, one owned execution role, two exact-machine-ARN sampling rules. No existing-resource mutation, Lambda, log groups, CloudTrail or synthetic PutTraceSegments. Sampling follow-up widens only owned-name ARN patterns, never account/global wildcards.
serialization: aws_cli.observe JSON outputs and typed native errors retained without field normalization. The two explicit HTTP-header precedence cases use botocore SigV4 and preserve the decoded native response body; credentials and signed request headers are never recorded.

findings.name: configuration-admission-does-not-require-xray-permission
findings.finding: A role with no inline or attached permissions admitted Standard creation with omitted tracing (described enabled:false), tracing-only update to true, and Express creation with enabled:true. Both enabled configurations described true.

findings.name: role-authority-and-bounded-missing-publication
findings.finding: Both executions without X-Ray permission succeeded but their sampled roots had no documents in six reads through 114.341s/113.281s after submission. After granting the documented four X-Ray actions, equivalent Standard and Express sampled roots produced native segments. Later negative/positive read ages are computed in publication_summary; absence is bounded, not a permanent guarantee.

findings.name: supplied-root-parent-and-unsampled-context
findings.finding: Valid supplied Root/Parent/Sampled headers were returned byte-for-byte, including Sampled=0. Positive segments use supplied trace_id and parent_id; valid Root without Parent returns without Parent and publishes a segment without parent_id. Supplied Sampled=0 roots had no observed documents within recorded windows.

findings.name: enabled-absent-and-malformed-generate-public-header
findings.finding: With enabled tracing, absent header, not-a-trace-header, and Root=not-enabled;Sampled=1 all became generated Root=1-...;Sampled=1 public response headers, without Parent. Native documents were read for each generated root; malformed request strings were not echoed.

findings.name: http-header-precedence-in-both-apis
findings.finding: A signed HTTP X-Amzn-Trace-Id with one sampled root overrode a conflicting body traceHeader with another unsampled root. Standard DescribeExecution and Express StartSyncExecution returned the HTTP header; actual documents used its root and parent. Only these two requests used the supplemental SigV4 transport.

findings.name: disabled-is-not-upstream-tracing-suppression
findings.finding: Both machine types with tracing enabled:false still published native documents for supplied valid Sampled=1 upstream roots. Supplied Sampled=0 remained unchanged with bounded no-publication, not execution failure.

findings.name: disabled-absent-differs-from-supplied-malformed
findings.finding: With tracing disabled, omitted traceHeader omitted the public response field. Supplying malformed nonempty headers instead generated canonical Sampled=1 roots and published native documents in both types. Their output revision was the updated disabled revision.

findings.name: explicit-empty-and-usable-sampling-decision
findings.finding: Both disabled machine types distinguish omitted input field from explicit empty string: empty generates a canonical Root;Sampled=1. Invalid Root=not-enabled;Sampled=0 replaces only the root and preserves Sampled=0. A valid Root with no Sampled retains the root and appends ;Sampled=1 in this capture. Responses used the updated disabled revision.

findings.name: open-execution-pins-tracing-and-definition
findings.finding: A running 70-second Wait execution retained enabled:true, original definition and original revision in DescribeStateMachineForExecution after the current machine was updated to enabled:false and a new Pass definition. It completed with original output; current machine described the updated definition and disabled tracing.

findings.name: owned-sampling-rules-admitted-but-effect-not-established
findings.finding: Initial over-32-character rule names were natively rejected; shorter names were admitted. Own exact-machine ARN/StepFunctions-type FixedRate=1 and then 0 rules were read back. All six absent-header requests after a 140s zero-rate propagation wait still returned Sampled=1 and published, while own rule statistics showed RequestCount=0. Follow-up widens only owned-name ARN kinds and ServiceType, retaining full outputs. Do not infer exact matching, honoring, or zero suppression from admission or timing.

findings.name: bounded-broader-rule-followup-and-generated-unsampled-root
findings.finding: After a second 140s propagation wait using only owned-name ARN patterns and wildcard ServiceType, three of four absent-header starts generated Sampled=1 and published. One enabled Sync Express absent-header start generated a public Root;Sampled=0 and had no documents through 103.238s. Own rules still reported RequestCount=0; this mixed result does not establish selection of either zero-rate rule. Explicit sampled-one upstream requests continued to publish.

findings.name: native-document-ownership-and-pass-subsegments
findings.finding: BatchGetTraces contains service-emitted documents, not probe PutTraceSegments. Origin is AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine; name is machine name, top-level resource_arn is machine ARN, aws.resource_arn is execution ARN. Pass state produces named Done subsegment with start_time/end_time and cause:{}; parent_id is present only when supplied in the captured valid contexts. Async Express StartExecution also produced a provider-owned document.

limitations: Only account 000000000000/us-west-2, one execution role and small Pass/Wait workflows were exercised. No default/global sampling rule was changed.

Observed publication is a positive provider-owned BatchGetTraces document correlated by aws.resource_arn. Missing documents are bounded observations, not proof of permanent non-publication; publication_summary records direct-root and scoped-discovery ages separately.

Exact-machine scoped sampling rules had zero reported requests and did not suppress publication during the captured propagation window. Rate-one positives therefore do not prove those rules were selected. The follow-up simultaneously widens only owned ARN-kind matching and ServiceType, so it cannot isolate either criterion by itself.

Sampling and service propagation poll intervals are measurement bounds, not AWS timing or determinism guarantees. No account-wide trace query was issued; GetTraceSummaries was filtered to each owned machine name.

GetSamplingRules and GetSamplingStatisticSummaries lack server-side rule-name filters; small bounded responses were retained verbatim, including the unchanged Default rule and any other returned native records.

This fixture preserves AWS CLI JSON timestamp serialization and modeled output fields; it is not a raw HTTP transcript. Explicit HTTP-header precedence calls retain decoded native response bodies and HTTP status.
Synthetic sampled upstream root/parent identifiers were submitted without a fabricated upstream root segment. No PutTraceSegments call was made; disconnected upstream topology is intentional.
Resource absence and retained trace/execution reads are cleanup evidence, not proof of indefinite retention. Native trace and execution identifiers are nonsecret; credentials were not serialized.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Staged, bounded native capture. Never changes unowned/default sampling rules."""
import datetime
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time
import uuid
import urllib.error
import urllib.request

from aws_cli import observe, run

ACCOUNT = '000000000000'
REGION = 'us-west-2'
DEST = Path('testdata/aws/stepfunctions/tracing_control.json')
ENV = dict(os.environ, AWS_REGION=REGION, AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=REGION,
           AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS='1', AWS_PAGER='')
PHASE = sys.argv[1]
if DEST.exists():
    F = json.loads(DEST.read_text())
else:
    prefix = 'sd-sfn-tracectl-' + uuid.uuid4().hex[:10]
    F = dict(service='stepfunctions', account=ACCOUNT, caller_account=ACCOUNT,
             region=REGION, prefix=prefix,
             captured_at=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
             scope='Two owned Standard/Express Pass/Wait machines, one owned execution role, two exact-machine-ARN sampling rules. No existing-resource mutation, Lambda, log groups, CloudTrail or synthetic PutTraceSegments.',
             serialization='aws_cli.observe JSON outputs and typed native errors retained without field normalization. The two explicit HTTP-header precedence cases use botocore SigV4 and preserve the decoded native response body; credentials and signed request headers are never recorded.',
             official_urls=[
                 'https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/concepts-xray-tracing.html',
                 'https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/apireference/API_StartExecution.html',
                 'https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/apireference/API_StartSyncExecution.html',
                 'https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/apireference/API_UpdateStateMachine.html',
                 'https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/xray-console-sampling.html',
                 'https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/api/API_CreateSamplingRule.html',
                 'https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/api/API_GetSamplingRules.html',
                 'https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/api/API_GetSamplingStatisticSummaries.html'],
             bounds=dict(roles=1, state_machines=2, sampling_rules=2, executions_max=64,
                         workflow_timeout_seconds=150, wait_seconds_max=70,
                         trace_poll_rounds_max=7, trace_poll_interval_seconds=20,
                         rule_propagation_wait_seconds=140, cleanup_wait_seconds=180,
                         sampling_list_pages_max=4, trace_summary_pages_max=4),
             findings=[], limitations=[], observations=[], cases=[], trace_windows=[],
             owned_resources=dict(role_name=prefix+'-role',
                                  role_arn=f'arn:aws:iam::{ACCOUNT}:role/{prefix}-role',
                                  machines={}, sampling_rules=[], executions=[]), cleanup={})
F['source'] = dict(path=str(Path(__file__)), text=Path(__file__).read_text())
P = F['prefix']
O = F['owned_resources']


def save():
    DEST.write_text(json.dumps(F, indent=2) + '\n')


def call(label, service, operation, parameters=None, http_header=None):
    parameters = parameters or {}
    started = int(time.time()*1000)
    if http_header is None:
        result = observe(service, operation, parameters, ENV, paginate=False)
    else:
        # aws_cli.run remains the credential transport; no credentials reach fixture.
        from botocore.auth import SigV4Auth
        from botocore.awsrequest import AWSRequest
        from botocore.credentials import Credentials
        raw = run('configure', 'export-credentials', None, ENV,
                  options=['--format', 'process'], timeout=30)
        if raw.returncode:
            raise RuntimeError('Credential export failed; diagnostics discarded')
        credentials = json.loads(raw.stdout)
        creds = Credentials(credentials['AccessKeyId'], credentials['SecretAccessKey'], credentials.get('SessionToken'))
        endpoint = ('sync-states' if operation == 'start-sync-execution' else 'states') + f'.{REGION}.amazonaws.com'
        target = ''.join(part.title() for part in operation.split('-'))
        request = AWSRequest(method='POST', url='https://'+endpoint+'/',
                             data=json.dumps(parameters).encode(),
                             headers={'Content-Type':'application/x-amz-json-1.0',
                                      'X-Amz-Target':'AWSStepFunctions.'+target,
                                      'X-Amzn-Trace-Id':http_header})
        SigV4Auth(creds, 'states', REGION).add_auth(request)
        prepared = request.prepare()
        req = urllib.request.Request(prepared.url, data=prepared.body, headers=dict(prepared.headers), method='POST')
        try:
            response = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=35)
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
            response = error
        with response:
            body = json.loads(response.read())
            result = dict(code='Success', output=body, http_status=response.status) if response.status < 300 else dict(code=body.get('__type','Unknown').split('#')[-1], error=body, http_status=response.status)
    row = dict(label=label, service=service,
               operation=''.join(part.title() for part in operation.split('-')),
               input=parameters, request_started_ms=started,
               request_finished_ms=int(time.time()*1000), result=result)
    if http_header is not None:
        row['http_headers'] = {'X-Amzn-Trace-Id':http_header}
    F['observations'].append(row)
    save()
    print(label, result['code'], flush=True)
    return result


def required(result):
    if result['code'] != 'Success':
        raise RuntimeError('Required native operation failed: '+result['code'])
    return result['output']


def identity():
    identity = required(call(PHASE+'-identity', 'sts', 'get-caller-identity'))
    if identity['Account'] != ACCOUNT:
        raise RuntimeError('Unauthorized account')


def definition(wait=False, revision='original'):
    states = {'Done': {'Type':'Pass','Result':{'revision':revision},'End':True}}
    if wait:
        states['Wait'] = {'Type':'Wait', 'SecondsPath':'$.seconds','Next':'Done'}
    return json.dumps({'StartAt':'Wait' if wait else 'Done','TimeoutSeconds':150,'States':states}, separators=(',',':'))


def trace_header(sample='1', parent=True):
    root = f'1-{int(time.time()):08x}-'+uuid.uuid4().hex[:24]
    return 'Root='+root+(';Parent='+uuid.uuid4().hex[:16] if parent else '')+';Sampled='+sample


def roots(header):
    return [part[5:] for part in (header or '').split(';') if part.startswith('Root=') and len(part[5:]) == 35]


def start(label, kind, header=None, seconds=None, http_header=None, async_express=False):
    if len(F['cases']) >= 64:
        raise RuntimeError('Execution bound exceeded')
    params = dict(stateMachineArn=O['machines'][kind], name=label, input=json.dumps({'case':label, **({'seconds':seconds} if seconds is not None else {})}))
    if header is not None:
        params['traceHeader'] = header
    operation = 'start-execution' if kind == 'standard' or async_express else 'start-sync-execution'
    result = call(label+'-start', 'stepfunctions', operation, params, http_header)
    case = dict(label=label, kind=kind, operation=operation, submitted_ms=F['observations'][-1]['request_started_ms'],
                body_trace_header=header, http_trace_header=http_header, trace_ids=list(dict.fromkeys(roots(header)+roots(http_header))),
                result_code=result['code'], execution_arn=result.get('output',{}).get('executionArn'))
    if case['execution_arn']:
        O['executions'].append(case['execution_arn'])
    if result.get('output',{}).get('traceHeader'):
        case['returned_trace_header'] = result['output']['traceHeader']
        case['trace_ids'] = list(dict.fromkeys(case['trace_ids']+roots(result['output']['traceHeader'])))
    F['cases'].append(case)
    save()
    return case


def describe_case(case, suffix='final', history=True):
    if case['kind'] != 'standard' or not case['execution_arn']:
        return
    params = {'executionArn':case['execution_arn']}
    result = call(case['label']+'-'+suffix+'-describe','stepfunctions','describe-execution',params)
    output = result.get('output',{})
    if output.get('traceHeader'):
        case['returned_trace_header'] = output['traceHeader']
        case['trace_ids'] = list(dict.fromkeys(case['trace_ids']+roots(output['traceHeader'])))
    case['status'] = output.get('status')
    if history:
        call(case['label']+'-'+suffix+'-history','stepfunctions','get-execution-history',{**params,'maxResults':100})
    save()


def collect(label, cases, rounds=1):
    trace_ids = list(dict.fromkeys(t for case in cases for t in case['trace_ids']))
    window = dict(label=label, case_labels=[c['label'] for c in cases], started_ms=int(time.time()*1000), observations=[], trace_ids=trace_ids)
    F['trace_windows'].append(window)
    for attempt in range(rounds):
        if attempt:
            time.sleep(20)
        for offset in range(0,len(trace_ids),5):
            name = f'{label}-round-{attempt:02d}-batch-{offset//5:02d}'
            call(name,'xray','batch-get-traces',{'TraceIds':trace_ids[offset:offset+5]})
            window['observations'].append(name)
        window['finished_ms'] = int(time.time()*1000)
        window['age_after_submission_seconds'] = {c['label']:round((window['finished_ms']-c['submitted_ms'])/1000,3) for c in cases}
        save()


def summaries(label):
    for kind, arn in O['machines'].items():
        params = {'StartTime': min(c['submitted_ms'] for c in F['cases'])/1000-10,
                  'EndTime':time.time()+1, 'Sampling':False,
                  'FilterExpression':f'service(id(name: "{arn.split(":")[-1]}", type: "AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine"))'}
        for page in range(4):
            result = call(f'{label}-{kind}-page-{page}','xray','get-trace-summaries',params)
            output = result.get('output',{})
            ids = [x['Id'] for x in output.get('TraceSummaries',[])]
            for offset in range(0,len(ids),5):
                call(f'{label}-{kind}-page-{page}-batch-{offset//5}','xray','batch-get-traces',{'TraceIds':ids[offset:offset+5]})
            if not output.get('NextToken'):
                break
            params['NextToken']=output['NextToken']


def rules(label):
    params={}
    for page in range(4):
        result=call(f'{label}-page-{page}','xray','get-sampling-rules',params)
        if not result.get('output',{}).get('NextToken'):
            return result
        params['NextToken']=result['output']['NextToken']
    F['limitations'].append(label+': sampling-rule listing exceeded four pages')
    save()
    return result


def admission():
    required(call('create-role','iam','create-role',{'RoleName':O['role_name'],'AssumeRolePolicyDocument':json.dumps({'Version':'2012-10-17','Statement':[{'Effect':'Allow','Principal':{'Service':'states.amazonaws.com'},'Action':'sts:AssumeRole'}]})}))
    call('role-without-inline-policies','iam','list-role-policies',{'RoleName':O['role_name']})
    call('role-without-attached-policies','iam','list-attached-role-policies',{'RoleName':O['role_name']})
    for kind in ('standard','express'):
        name=P+'-'+kind
        params={'name':name,'roleArn':O['role_arn'],'definition':definition(),'type':kind.upper()}
        if kind=='express':
            params['tracingConfiguration']={'enabled':True}
        for attempt in range(8):
            result=call(f'create-{kind}-without-xray-permission-{attempt}','stepfunctions','create-state-machine',params)
            if result['code']=='Success':
                break
            if result['code'] not in ('InvalidArn','AccessDeniedException'):
                break
            time.sleep(5)
        O['machines'][kind]=required(result)['stateMachineArn']
        call('describe-'+kind+'-created','stepfunctions','describe-state-machine',{'stateMachineArn':O['machines'][kind]})
        if kind=='standard':
            call('enable-standard-without-xray-permission','stepfunctions','update-state-machine',{'stateMachineArn':O['machines'][kind],'tracingConfiguration':{'enabled':True}})
        call('describe-'+kind+'-enabled-no-permission','stepfunctions','describe-state-machine',{'stateMachineArn':O['machines'][kind]})
        rule={'RuleName':P+'-'+kind,'Priority':1,'FixedRate':1.0,'ReservoirSize':0,'Host':'*','ServiceName':'*','ServiceType':'AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine','ResourceARN':O['machines'][kind],'HTTPMethod':'*','URLPath':'*','Version':1,'Attributes':{}}
        result=call('create-'+kind+'-owned-one-rule','xray','create-sampling-rule',{'SamplingRule':rule})
        if result['code']=='Success':
            O['sampling_rules'].append(rule['RuleName'])
        save()
    rules('rules-after-create')
    denied=[]
    for kind in O['machines']:
        denied.append(start('no-permission-'+kind,kind,trace_header()))
    time.sleep(5)
    for case in denied:
        describe_case(case)
    collect('no-permission-window',denied,6)


def authorized():
    # Preserve the rejected overlength rule-name observations, then use short names.
    if not O['sampling_rules']:
        for kind, arn in O['machines'].items():
            rule={'RuleName':P+'-'+kind[:3],'Priority':1,'FixedRate':1.0,'ReservoirSize':0,'Host':'*','ServiceName':'*','ServiceType':'AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine','ResourceARN':arn,'HTTPMethod':'*','URLPath':'*','Version':1,'Attributes':{}}
            required(call('create-'+kind+'-short-owned-one-rule','xray','create-sampling-rule',{'SamplingRule':rule}))
            O['sampling_rules'].append(rule['RuleName'])
            save()
        rules('rules-after-short-create')

def cleanup():
    for case in F['cases']:
        if case['kind']=='standard' and case.get('execution_arn'):
            result=call(case['label']+'-cleanup-status','stepfunctions','describe-execution',{'executionArn':case['execution_arn']})
            if result.get('output',{}).get('status')=='RUNNING':
                call(case['label']+'-cleanup-stop','stepfunctions','stop-execution',{'executionArn':case['execution_arn']})
    for name in O['sampling_rules']:
        call('delete-rule-'+name,'xray','delete-sampling-rule',{'RuleName':name})
    rules('cleanup-rule-absence')
    for kind,arn in O['machines'].items():
        call('delete-'+kind,'stepfunctions','delete-state-machine',{'stateMachineArn':arn})
    pending=dict(O['machines'])
    deadline=time.monotonic()+180
    attempt=0
    while pending and time.monotonic()<deadline:
        for kind,arn in list(pending.items()):
            result=call(f'cleanup-{kind}-absence-{attempt}','stepfunctions','describe-state-machine',{'stateMachineArn':arn})
            if result['code']=='StateMachineDoesNotExist':
                del pending[kind]
        if pending:
            time.sleep(10)
        attempt+=1
    retained=next(c for c in F['cases'] if c['label']=='allowed-standard-sampled-one')
    call('cleanup-closed-execution-after-machine-absence','stepfunctions','describe-execution',{'executionArn':retained['execution_arn']})
    call('cleanup-trace-after-machine-absence','xray','batch-get-traces',{'TraceIds':retained['trace_ids']})
    result=call('delete-role-xray-policy','iam','delete-role-policy',{'RoleName':O['role_name'],'PolicyName':'owned-xray'})
    call('delete-role','iam','delete-role',{'RoleName':O['role_name']})
    absent=call('cleanup-role-absence','iam','get-role',{'RoleName':O['role_name']})
    F['cleanup'].update(finished_at=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                        machines_pending=list(pending), role_absence_code=absent['code'],
                        retained='No per-trace or per-execution delete API was used. Post-machine-deletion DescribeExecution and BatchGetTraces capture retained presence/absence explicitly; no indefinite retention guarantee. No synthetic root segments were submitted.')
    save()
